name: Emrys Of Sheorya
source:
Magic Affinity: None

The royal family of Sheorya is said to be evasive, unpredictable, and ruthless. In proper fashion, Emrys is boasted as the incarnation of all these traits. 

For generations, the Crown Prince is the only one in the royal family that has shown himself in public, which has brought about many rumors even among his people.

Although poisonous in both his words and actions, it's a well-known fact that Emrys is not able to use any kind of magic. Still, you'd better think twice before crossing him. You may not live to regret it.

[From Kickstarter]
